This '''Zillo Beast''' was the last member of its [[Zillo Beast/Legends|kind]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the beast was awakened during the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and caused chaos on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], destroying Dug camps and Republic troops and vehicles alike. The Republic managed to stun the Zillo beast by using [[RX-200 Falchion-class assault tank/Legends|RX-200 ''Falchion''-class assault tanks]]. It was brought to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for study, but it was [[Zillo Beast incident/Legends|killed]] there when it broke out of its [[Republic Science and Technical Center/Legends|research facility]].
